Startup dialog (SPEC-startup-templates)

• Shows on every launch once the engine is ready. No close button at launch; Escape = Blank.
• Selection is cyan; the sample file name is amber because it is data.
• Thumbnails are build-time renders of each example (drawn here as sketches).
• Double-click a card, or Enter, opens it. Examples open in Preview with their sample JSON loaded.

Reopened from New… over a document with unsaved changes

• Author picked Invoice and pressed Open example; the footer turns into the confirmation (CAP-6).
• Keep editing returns to the normal footer, nothing lost. Discard and open replaces the document.
• Same confirmation for Start blank and Open existing file…; no confirmation when nothing is unsaved.
• Close button and Escape keep the current document.
• Save sample data (CAP-7) lives with the existing sample data controls — not drawn here.
